items.html: And indeed we must clarify the matter of the three changes of these Mochin, which exist in pregnancy, nursing, and the second pregnancy. And the matter is in what was said concerning the second pregnancy, of the Mochin of Gadlut, at length, and see there. But the matter, in short, is that the Mochin are the phase of Nefesh and life to ZA, and they are in the likeness of a Partzuf that is refined and very spiritual, complete in ten Sefirot, and it expands within the vessels of ZA and within his body to give him life; and it is the phase of a single Tzelem, which has three aspects corresponding to the three letters of Tzelem: the Lamed and the Mem are surrounding, and the Tzadi is inner light. And these three aspects are called Tzelem.
